phrase.zh: 把炽热的等离子体留在磁场里。
phrase.en: Hold a hot plasma with magnetic fields.

visual.zh: 环形装置与内部光带形成受约束的旋转空间，表现托卡马克的磁约束思路。图中装置不是某台设备的工程图。
visual.en: A circular machine and inner glow evoke magnetic confinement in a tokamak. It is not an engineering drawing of a particular device.

background.zh: 核聚变需要足够高的温度、粒子密度和约束时间。ITER 采用托卡马克方案，用磁场约束和控制高温等离子体；这是一项实验工程，画面不表示已实现商业供电。
background.en: Fusion requires sufficiently high temperature, particle density and confinement time. ITER is an experimental tokamak designed to use magnetic fields to confine and control hot plasma; the image does not imply commercial power has been delivered.
